crossRefs.note: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

translations.web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
translations.bsb: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
translations.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save
translations.asv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.
